devs_collected_rules.rule: When a stock doubles, sell half — the remaining half becomes free of cost
Hold the free-of-cost half for ten years
January: cash in · February: keep cash · March: reinvest · April–September: weekly SIP · November–December: plan exit
devs_collected_rules.note: seasonal heuristic — folk wisdom, not a verified strategy

devs_collected_rules.rule: Market participants: brokers(pro) 57.8%, individuals 26.8%, FII 6.1%, corporates 4.3%, others 4.9%, DII 0.1% (May 2023 data)
devs_collected_rules.note: retail is a small player — smart money moves the market

devs_collected_rules.rule: Phase-3 bull tops are driven by external factors (geopolitics, US panic) — professionals create panic where retail holds average positions
